series.title: The Olive Oil Inheritance

characters.name: Mama Olive
characters.look: A plump glossy dark green olive woman with sharp painted eyebrows, red lipstick, pearl necklace and a tight purple designer dress with a fur stole.

characters.name: Grape Gary
characters.look: A shiny round purple grape young man with a smug grin, slicked hair, sunglasses on his head, gold chains and a white tracksuit with gold sneakers.

characters.name: Lime Lucy
characters.look: A small bright green lime girl with big hopeful eyes, freckles, a messy ponytail and a faded patched brown apron over a plain grey dress.

characters.name: Judge Coconut
characters.look: A large hairy brown coconut man with bushy white eyebrows, round glasses and a long black judge's robe.

so_far: Part 1: Mama Olive sues Lime Lucy for stealing the family recipe to give Grape Gary everything, but her own recipe book proves Lucy invented it.
series.cliffhanger: A mysterious stranger bursts into court with a frozen jar of oil that could change who really owns the family fortune.

history.title: His Best Friend Swapped the Plans at Midnight (Part 1)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 1): Carrot Carl secretly swaps Broccoli Bob's blueprints, making Bob sink the boss's trailer and get fired while Carl takes his bulldozer.

history.title: The Fired Worker Found the Fake Blueprint (Part 2)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 2): Bob finds the fake blueprint covered in orange dust, Carl nearly crushes the evidence with the bulldozer, and Mr Pineapple catches them both just as Carl blames Bob.

history.title: One Orange Smudge Exposed the Real Saboteur (Part 3)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 3): Mr Pineapple traces the carrot dust to Carl, who flees in the bulldozer and sinks it in the mud pit, while Bob rescues him, becomes foreman and gets his bulldozer back.

history.title: He Lied About Owning the Restaurant (Part 1)
history.premise: The Champagne Liar (part 1): Broke Lemon Lenny lies to Madame Plum that he owns a champagne empire and the fancy restaurant, then gets handed a giant bill and a mysterious note from the quiet waiter.

history.title: He Filled Champagne Bottles With Lemon Water (Part 2)
history.premise: The Champagne Liar (part 2): Pierre confronts Lenny in the kitchen and demands he tell Sofia the truth, but Lenny fills the champagne bottles with sour lemon water instead, raising Madame Plum's suspicions.

history.title: The Quiet Waiter Was the Real Owner All Along (Part 3)
history.premise: The Champagne Liar (part 3): Pierre reveals he owns the restaurant, Madame Plum exposes the lemon water, and Lenny gets stuck washing dishes to pay his bill while Sofia finds happiness with honest Pierre.

history.title: The Muddy Potato Who Silenced the Whole Farm (Part 1)
history.premise: The Farm VIP Star (part 1): Mocked outcast Potato Pip shocks the farm with a perfect-score song at the talent show, but on the eve of the final his microphone vanishes and a cherry stem is left behind.

history.title: His Mic Was Stolen So Granny Built Him One (Part 2)
history.premise: The Farm VIP Star (part 2): Granny Corn helps Pip build a tin can microphone and he wows the final, but Celeste secretly slips a fake note into the judge's winner envelope.

history.title: The Tin Can Mic Caught the Cheater Red-Handed (Part 3)
history.premise: The Farm VIP Star (part 3): Pip's tin can microphone exposes Celeste's forged winner note, she is disqualified and sent to sweep the stage, and Pip is crowned the Farm VIP Star with Granny Corn by his side.

history.title: She Sued Her Own Daughter Over a Secret Recipe (Part 1)
history.premise: The Olive Oil Inheritance (part 1): Mama Olive sues Lime Lucy for stealing the family recipe to give Grape Gary everything, but her own recipe book proves Lucy invented it.
